title: Hooded Quilted Puffer Jacket
description:
Stay warm and comfortable in Nobero’s Hooded Quilted Puffer Jacket, designed with a regular fit and a lightweight 100% Nylon 380T outer fabric. It features horizontal channel quilting with insulated polyfill padding, along with a fixed three-panel hood for added coverage. Vertical welt pockets at the lower front provide convenient storage, while the full center-front opening with a nylon coil zipper makes it easy to wear. A convenient storage pouch makes the jacket easy to pack and carry when not in use, while the graphic detailing adds a unique touch to the design. With its clean and functional design, this puffer jacket is a versatile choice for cooler days.
